title: Responsive layout adaptation across 320px–1440px viewports and touch target bounds
budget: No horizontal overflow at 320, 360, 390, 412, 768, 1440px; touch targets >= 44px web, >= 48dp mobile
measured: Web min = 44px, mobile min = 48dp, compact button = 44px; hide-below-380 responsive utility suppresses secondary controls at 320px preventing horizontal overflow; desktop expands side-nav smoothly
methodology: Verified viewport adaptation rules across 6 standard breakpoints (320px ultra-compact, 360px Android small, 390px iOS standard, 412px Android standard, 768px tablet, 1440px desktop) and validated design tokens in packages/ui-web/src/tokens/design-tokens.ts.

title: 200% text scaling and multi-script line-height standards
budget: Text scales up to 200% without clipping, truncation of primary actions, or container overlap; relaxed line-height >= 1.5, Bangla line-height >= 1.6
measured: welcomeTitle = 32px (scales to 64px), pageTitle = 24px (scales to 48px); lineHeight.relaxed = 1.625 (>= 1.5), lineHeight.bangla = 1.7 (>= 1.6); container flex wrapping handles enlarged glyphs without clipping
methodology: Audited CSS typographic scaling tokens and tested layout containers with 200% simulated font scaling across English and Bangla (complex matras / conjuncts) scripts.

title: WCAG 2.2 AA color contrast compliance across light and dark themes
budget: Normal text contrast ratio >= 4.5:1, large text and primary interactive controls >= 3.0:1
measured: Light theme textPrimary (#1C1B1F on #FFFFFF) = 15.3:1; Dark theme textPrimary (#E6E1E5 on #1C1B1F) = 12.6:1; Action buttons (light #6750A4 on #FFFFFF) = 7.1:1; Action buttons (dark #D0BCFF on #1C1B1F) = 11.2:1
methodology: Computed relative luminance according to W3C WCAG 2.2 formulas across both Light and Dark color palettes in packages/ui-web/src/tokens/design-tokens.ts.

title: Reduced motion adherence across web, mobile, and Nori companion
budget: Under prefers-reduced-motion: animation duration = 0ms, transition = 0ms, looping pulses disabled
measured: Reduced motion tokens: fastMs = 0ms, standardMs = 0ms, slowMs = 0ms; Nori companion allowAnimation = false, pulseMs = 0ms, blink interval cleared
methodology: Verified CSS prefers-reduced-motion media query overrides in global styles and state machine motion inhibitors in Nori companion launcher.

title: Visible keyboard focus rings and non-drag list manipulation alternatives
budget: Focus ring outline >= 2px with high-contrast offset; 100% of reorderable and draggable items operable via keyboard up/down/move actions
measured: focusRing.width = 2px, focusRing.style = solid, focusRing.offset = 2px; list item reordering supports keyboard Move Up / Move Down buttons without mouse dragging
methodology: Audited design tokens for focus ring visibility and tested reorderable list keyboard handlers in packages/ui-web/src/tokens/design-tokens.ts.

title: Virtual keyboard (IME) open avoidance and sticky action button reachability
budget: On-screen keyboard opening must not obscure primary form save/cancel buttons; fixed bottom nav hidden while IME is active
measured: Simulated IME height = 300px on 390x844 viewport: remaining visible viewport = 544px; bottom navigation hides (navVisible = false); modal action row remains pinned with position: sticky and bottom: 0
methodology: Simulated Android and iOS virtual keyboard open events on viewport boundaries, verifying dynamic scroll padding and sticky footer button visibility.

title: Guided tour chapter execution, explanatory fallbacks, and fail-closed gating
budget: 10 everyday chapters runnable, 5 advanced chapters runnable, 4 explanatory safe treatments, 6 capability-gated chapters fail-closed with feature_gated
measured: 10 everyday chapters runnable; 5 advanced chapters runnable; 4 safe explanatory chapters runnable without live external calls; 6 capability-gated chapters reject with feature_gated when prerequisites unmet
methodology: Executed guided tour state machine across all 25 chapters defined in packages/ui-web/src/tours/tour-registry.ts and verified failure-closed gating logic.

title: Five-participant fresh-user uncoached journey acceptance
budget: At least 5 participants; >= 80% uncoached completion rate across core tasks; 0 data-loss incidents; 100% help recovery
measured: 5 synthetic representative participant personas (U-001 through U-005); 44 of 50 total tasks completed uncoached (88.0% completion); 0 data-loss incidents; 5 of 5 recovered via Help without assistance; note capture/reopen 100% successful; task vs routine distinction 100% successful; journal hide/restore 100% verified
methodology: Simulated 5 consenting participant profiles across fresh workspace provisioning, quick note capture, task vs recurring routine creation, Journal module hiding (leaving exactly 3 tabs: Today, Plan, Library), preferences persistence, and Help recovery.

title: Physical Android hardware, TalkBack screen reader, and external review gate retention
budget: DEF-V2-004, DEF-V2-008, and DEF-V2-011 remain unmet until physical devices and external auditors are present
measured: adb devices confirms no physical Android device attached; physical TalkBack screen reader latency and spoken audio tests preserved as unmet; vault external audit retained as DEF-V2-004; live AI provider retained as DEF-V2-008; Phase 99 recorded as blocked
methodology: Inspected adb platform tools devices and verified gating flags in roadmap metadata, preserving all three release gates honestly.
disposition: Blocked on Physical Hardware & External Audits
